build: Production build on localhost, PayPal sandbox, Postgres 17

suites.name: Rules engine, routing, the SSA report, the checks workflow and the cited answers
suites.what: Every rule row, the 2026 values, the $60 quarterly exclusion in the order gifts arrive, shelter and the one-third reduction's meals test, prepaid housing bills, ABLE, gift routing, monthly gifts month by month, the Easy Read report in English and Spanish (every sentence 15 words or fewer) and its calendar reminder, pronouns, the reviewers' referee and what it does when one reviewer is wrong, the monthly report to Social Security, the checks workflow's fan-out and retries, the AG Studio to Claude translation, a known source behind every real-world answer, Social Security's own worked examples, and the benefit calendar

suites.name: API end to end
suites.what: Gift checks, presets, bill and fundraiser reading, the two reviewers, gift pages, the monthly SSA report and its CSV, the MCP server, the outside checks and their shared secret, PayPal orders, routed gifts, fund payouts and their reconciliation, receipts, webhook signature checks, the ledger, developer keys and every error path

suites.name: Browser end to end
suites.what: The Gift Checker, Try it, the two reviewers, a fundraiser turned into a gift page, For agents, the AG Studio dashboard and its assistant, For organizations, the gift page and its real-world answers, the benefit calendar, keyboard use, and the developer flow

suites.name: Accessibility and layout
suites.what: axe WCAG 2.2 AA on 23 pages, including the SSA report as given and as cash, its Easy Read version in English and Spanish, a giver's monthly gift page, the benefit calendar, a generated gift page, For agents, the AG Studio dashboard and For organizations, at desktop and phone widths, light and dark, with no sideways scroll

suites.name: Real PayPal checkout, logged in as the sandbox buyer
suites.what: Both PayPal buttons: the buyer logs in and approves, PayPal captures every payee, the page updates, and the public receipt matches

suites.name: An AI agent starts a checkout over MCP
suites.what: The agent calls start_gift_checkout, the sandbox buyer approves the PayPal link, and Giftwise captures on return and shows the receipt

suites.name: A monthly gift, two months, as the sandbox buyer
suites.what: Start $300 a month, approve the first month in PayPal, plan the next, check the rules routed it again with what changed and why, approve it, and confirm each order paid every purchase unit to its own payee

suites.name: Outside checks, as Render Workflows runs them
suites.what: Every failure case against the PayPal sandbox, every page on the judges' path (now with the Easy Read report in Spanish) and six public API promises, all at once, the same list the nightly Render Workflow runs

suites.name: Failure cases, live
suites.what: Run the eight failure cases on this page yourself
